# Third-Party Notice

This repository contains a SEGS prototype and integration code adapted from prior research code.

## Upstream Integration

- Gaussian text-to-3D integration code was adapted from EnVision-Research/LucidDreamer.
- Upstream repository: https://github.com/EnVision-Research/LucidDreamer
- Upstream license: MIT License. See upstream license text before redistributing modified integration files.

## Model and Library Dependencies

- Stable Diffusion checkpoints are provided by their respective model owners and licenses.
- OpenCLIP is used for target-view reference selection.
- pyiqa/BRISQUE is used for quality-aware guidance attenuation in the recovered prototype.

The public SEGS release should keep this notice and include license files for redistributed third-party code.
